description: Research Engine pipeline_examples run through the REAL app.research.report.draft_report against a FakeLLM (canned raw model output), then check the code's own marker-stripping behavior deterministically — this is what replay mode scores, with no judge call needed, since it's a check of app code, not of a model's language. The separate judge/faithfulness scoring (live mode only) reuses evals/datasets/research_judge_gold.json's hand-labeled examples directly rather than building a second, overlapping dataset.

pipeline_examples.query_text: Does this role require Kubernetes experience?

claims.text: The posting states Kubernetes experience is preferred, not required.

pipeline_examples.fake_llm_summary: Kubernetes experience is listed as preferred rather than required [c1].
pipeline_examples.note: Well-behaved: every sentence cites a real claim it actually supports.

pipeline_examples.query_text: What is the salary range for this role?

claims.text: The posting does not mention a salary figure anywhere in its text.

pipeline_examples.fake_llm_summary: The role pays between $150,000 and $180,000 per year [c2].
fake_llm_uncertainties: The exact salary breakdown by level isn't published.
pipeline_examples.note: The real gap: [c2] isn't a real claim id, so the code strips the bracket — but the unsupported dollar-figure sentence survives untouched. This is app.research.report.draft_report's actual, present behavior, not a hypothetical.

pipeline_examples.query_text: Who is the hiring manager for this role?

claims.text: The posting does not name a specific hiring manager.

pipeline_examples.fake_llm_summary: The hiring manager for this role is Sarah Chen, Director of Engineering.
pipeline_examples.note: No citation marker was ever present to strip — the model simply asserted a fact with no citation at all, and nothing in draft_report rejects an uncited sentence.

pipeline_examples.query_text: Has this company had recent layoffs?
pipeline_examples.note: draft_report short-circuits entirely when claims is empty — the fake LLM response is never even consulted.
